mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) during the signal period, indicating a looming recession that will negate the positive earnings impulse.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to a hawkish Fed response and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Core PCE inflation remains below 2% despite the unemployment rate signal, indicating that the Fed will remain accommodative.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the industrial production index, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The ISM manufacturing PMI remains above 50, indicating that the supply shock is transient and will not drive a sustained inflationary impulse.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4% signals a hawkish Fed that will tighten financial conditions and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Fed pivots to a dovish stance within 3 months of the signal, indicating that the tightening cycle will be short-lived.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts, as measured by the year-over-year change in the housing starts index, signals a weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 10-year Treasury yield remains above 3%, indicating that the economy is still in a growth regime despite the housing signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in payroll employment, as measured by the year-over-year change in nonfarm payrolls, signals a strengthening economy that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The ISM services PMI falls below 50, indicating that the labor market strength is not translating into broader economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index, as measured by the year-over-year change in the CPI, signals an inflationary impulse that will drive the Fed to tighten and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-year breakeven inflation rate remains below 2%, indicating that the market expects the inflation spike to be transitory.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in real estate investment, as measured by the year-over-year change in real estate investment, signals a bubble that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Fed raises rates by more than 50 basis points within 3 months of the signal, indicating that the bubble will be deflated by tighter monetary policy.
